bibl.title: Un frammento del Digesto di Giustiniano in PRyl III 480 (+ 479).
bibl.seg: Marco Fressura, Un frammento del Digesto di Giustiniano in PRyl III 480 (+ 479).
bibl.note: New edition of P. Ryl. III, 480 (= C.P.L. 96; MP3 2966.10; LDAB 5982), here identified as belonging to the 28th book of Justinian's Digest. The fragment, as well as P. Ryl. III, 479 (= C.P.L. 89; MP3 2967; LDAB 2554), comes from a sixth-century papyrus codex that was part of an edition of the Digest in multiple tomes.
